ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with approximately 20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution forming a speckled pattern.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling is distributed across both lobes. A high-density cluster of contiguous white pixels forms a horizontal-trending band on the mid-section of the right lobe. The left lobe exhibits more dispersed, discrete white spots and several narrow vertical linear features.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated aperture of approximately 75 degrees; the vertex is sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire visible boundary. The right lobe trailing edge contains a significant non-uniform indentation (loss of material) approximately 20% of the distance from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct convex curve from the median notch toward the distal tips, which are acutely tapered.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters, typically 5-15 pixels in diameter, are visible across the upper-mid surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, near-vertical linear high-intensity disruptions. A set of three parallel vertical marks is present on the lower-left lobe; two additional vertical marks are visible on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent irregular notch on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe and multiple vertical rake marks across the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe features a unique, dense 'spray' of white pigment in its mid-region that is distinctly more concentrated than the patterns on the left lobe.
